Sedative Hypnotics 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-637194  
Guideline Name 
Sedative Hypnotics  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
7/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:generic ramelteon  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Step Therapy  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to a trial of at least TWO of the following 
preferred agents:  
• 
Eszopiclone (Generic Lunesta)  
• 
Zolpidem/Zolpidem ER (Generic Ambien/Ambien CR)  
• 
Temazepam 15/30 mg (milligram) capsules (Generic Restoril)  


--- PDF page 1495 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1495 
 
Product Name:Brand Ambien, Brand Ambien CR, zolpidem SL, Edluar, Belsomra, estazolam, 
Brand Lunesta, flurazepam, triazolam, Brand Halcion, Brand Restoril, generic temazepam 7.5 
mg and 22.5 mg, Brand Rozerem, generic doxepin, Brand Silenor, zaleplon, Quviviq, Dayvigo  
Diagnosis 
Non-Preferred  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to a trial of at least TWO of the following 
preferred agents:  
• 
Eszopiclone (Generic Lunesta)  
• 
Zolpidem/Zolpidem ER (Generic Ambien/Ambien CR)  
• 
Temazepam 15/30 mg (milligram) capsules (Generic Restoril)  
 
AND 
 
2 - If the request is for Brand Rozerem, patient must have tried and failed generic ramelteon  
 
Product Name:Brand Ambien, generic zolpidem, Brand Ambien CR, generic zolpidem ER, 
zolpidem SL, Edluar, Belsomra, estazolam, generic eszopiclone, Brand Lunesta, flurazepam, 
triazolam, Brand Halcion, Brand Restoril, generic temazepam, generic ramelteon, Brand 
Rozerem, generic doxepin, Brand Silenor, zaleplon, Quviviq, Dayvigo  
Diagnosis 
Greater than 1 hypnotic in 30 days  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The requested medication is being used to adjust the dose of the drug  
 
OR 


--- PDF page 1496 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1496 
 
2 - The requested medication will be used in place of the previously prescribed drug, and not 
in addition to it  
 
OR 
 
3 - The requested medication dosage form will be used in place of the previously prescribed 
medication dosage form, and not in addition to it  
 
OR 
 
4 - The physician attests they are aware of the multiple sedative hypnotics prescribed to the 
patient and feels treatment with both medications is medically necessary (Document rationale 
for use)  
 
Product Name:Brand Ambien, generic zolpidem, Brand Ambien CR, generic zolpidem ER, 
zolpidem SL, Edluar, Belsomra, estazolam, generic eszopiclone, Brand Lunesta, flurazepam, 
triazolam, Brand Halcion, Brand Restoril, generic temazepam, generic ramelteon, Brand 
Rozerem, generic doxepin, Brand Silenor, zaleplon, Quviviq, Dayvigo  
Diagnosis 
Requests for Patients less than 6 years of age  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient is unresponsive to other treatment modalities, unless contraindicated (i.e., 
other medications or behavioral modification attempted)  
 
AND 
 
2 - The physician attests that the requested medication is medically necessary (Document 
rationale for use)
